items.summary: The Directorate General of Taxpayer Services (DGTS) and the CGST Goa Commissionerate highlighted digital-first, taxpayer-centric reform measures being undertaken through the "Bharat Sarkar Aapke Dwaar" initiative in Goa. Shri Sumit Kumar, Principal Additional Director General, DGTS, Mumbai, shared this information during a joint press conference held in Panaji today.
items.title: DGTS and CGST Goa Highlight Digital-First, Taxpayer-Centric Reforms Through "Bharat Sarkar Aapke Dwaar" Initiative – Shri Sumit Kumar

items.summary: The Centre for Research on International Trade (CRIT), New Delhi, in partnership with the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT), New Delhi, organised a three-day Orientation Course on Trade Negotiations from 28 to 30 September 2026 in New Delhi. items.title: CRIT and IIFT Organise Three-Day Orientation Course on Trade Negotiations
